title: UI Event Envelope v1
description: The self-describing JSON envelope every named controls.wasm UI event rides over the env.host_event(ptr,len) import (controls_abi_version >= 2). RIGID GENERIC ENVELOPE with a DYNAMIC PAYLOAD: the map is CLOSED (unknown keys REJECT — additionalProperties:false is the no-freestyle enforcement); only value/extra stay open (the dynamic meaning). Deliberately NO timestamp/uuid on the wire: the wasm imports no clock (pixel-determinism doctrine) — seq is its identity; time enters at the HOST membrane as observation metadata, never wire content. See docs/INTERFACE-CONTRACTS.md §8 (the host_event import) and §9 G5 (the golden vectors emitters must reproduce).

v.description: Envelope schema version. A breaking envelope change bumps this const in a NEW schema revision; consumers fail fast on an unknown v (no migration branch — the protogen evolution loop rebuilds consumers in lockstep).

tag.description: EventBinding.name — the event keyword, which IS the command identifier the host maps on (e.g. 'dayCamera.setZoomTableValue'). minLength/maxLength mirror ui.EventBinding.name's min_len/max_len (proto/ui/ui_ast.proto) and share their unit: both count CHARACTERS (Unicode code points), never bytes. What binds the PRODUCER is a BYTE bound instead — the nanopb max_size for that field (proto/ui/ui_ast.options) less its NUL terminator, which renderer.h's UI_EVENT_NAME_BUF holds the event cache and the envelope serializer to — and JSON Schema has no byte-length keyword, so that bound is NOT expressible here: a tag carrying multi-byte characters can satisfy this schema and still overflow the decoder. Passing here is NECESSARY, not SUFFICIENT. An EMPTY name emits no envelope at all.

origin.description: The firing widget's codegen-assigned uid (FNV-1a-32 of its identity path — the same uid controls_dump_tree reports and ScreenPatch ops address). 0 when the node carried no uid.

event.description: The trigger that fired, kebab-case. The v1 renderer emits 'clicked' (the EventBinding default), 'value-changed' and 'long-pressed'; the remaining values are RESERVED for host-membrane and future-trigger use so validators share ONE enum.

seq.description: Per-module-instance monotonic emission counter. The shipped renderer emits CONSECUTIVE values from 1 (never reset by screen load/destroy within an instance), so a host gap-check detects loss across the whole session.

value.description: Dynamic payload (open type). The v1 renderer emits the binding's integer value — the SAME int the cmd.* template path patches (post widget-value injection / toggle).

extra.description: Reserved open side-channel for structured payload extensions (dynamic meaning; the envelope stays rigid around it). The v1 renderer never emits it.
